Message:
These flower-like growths
drain the life of
anything they touch,
whether I want them to or not.

My friend was okay this time,
but another accident
could actually cost her life.

Recalling the sight of my friend
writhing on the ground,
I left town as quickly as I could.

Each plant I passed withered
in the blink of an eye...

as if I were the
Grim Reaper himself.

But with each death,
new flower-like growths
sprouted all over my body.

Almost as if
they were flaunting
all the lives
they had stolen...!

I don’t want to hurt anyone!
I never wanted this,
not even once...!

Go away!
Get off of me!
Just disappear already...!!
